events.title: BORE joins Steam Next Fest - Play the free demo
events.summary: PLAY THE FREE BORE DEMO BORE is taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to October 26. The free demo is available now. BORE is a co-op horror game for 1–4 players. You can play alone or online with friends. Travel deep underground in a large drilling machine. Leave the machine to explore caves and collect valuable specimens. events.title: The final Next Fest demo is live: 17 updates in 38 days
events.summary: THE FINAL NEXT FEST DEMO IS LIVE BORE Demo v0.8.16 is live on Steam now. This is the build you will play during Steam Next Fest, October 19-26: co-op survival horror for 1-4 players, solo or with a crew. Getting it here took 17 updates in 38 days. From September 8 to October 15 we deployed a new build to Steam roughly every two days, five of them in the first four days alone. events.title: THE FULL CONTRACT OPENS NOVEMBER 24
events.summary: THE FULL CONTRACT OPENS TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 24 BORE launches on Steam on November 24, 2026, at $5.99, with 20% off for the first two weeks. The demo gave you the first two strata. The full contract opens the rest of the earth: THE OSSUARY, which is warm for reasons nobody wrote down, and THE HUSH, which the Bureau does not discuss. Deeper is richer. Deeper is louder. events.title: THE PROVISIONAL CONTRACT IS OPEN
events.summary: THE BUREAU IS ACCEPTING PROVISIONAL CONTRACTS A demo is now posted. It is free, it is the real machine, and it runs the first two strata: THE FILL and THE OLD SEA. You will crew THE MULE, a church-sized drilling machine, and take it down. You will man its instruments, seal its door, and walk out into the dark for the specimens the Bureau calls the tribute. events.title: CONTROLLER AND STEAM DECK SUPPORT
events.summary: CONTROLLER AND STEAM DECK BORE has full controller support, and it runs on Steam Deck. This post is the detail. It gets updated as things change, so it is worth a second look after a patch. FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT Every verb is on the pad: moving, the lamp, tools, the cabin stations, the Stores, the menus, the survey plot.
